set.typical_award_size: Requirement, not a subsidy. Applies to residential development of 10 or more units outside the Coastal Overlay Zone, 5 or more units inside the Coastal Overlay Zone, and condominium conversions of 2 or more units (SDMC 142.1302). Rental: at least 10 percent of total units for very low or low income households at rents not exceeding 30 percent of 60 percent of AMI (fully effective July 1, 2024). For-sale: 10 percent at median income (100 percent AMI) or 15 percent at moderate income (120 percent AMI). In lieu fee $25.00 per square foot of net building area of unrestricted market-rate units effective July 1, 2024, updated annually by the ENR Los Angeles Construction Cost Index ($12.73 for projects deemed complete before July 1, 2020). Other compliance: off-site units, rehabilitation or conversion of existing units, SRO or hotel rooms to 55-year affordable units, land donation. North City Future Urbanizing Area projects are exempt from this Division and follow the Framework Plan inclusionary requirement (20 percent). IHF fee revenue FY25 $17.76M (255 percent above budget); FY27 projected new IHF revenue $4.04M.
